node_action.description: Tags a contact, saves a detail, assigns the conversation. Several at once, in order.

node_condition.description: Splits the flow in two, on what you know about the contact.

node_data_collection.description: Asks a question and saves the answer on the contact. Checks emails and phone numbers look real.

node_external_request.description: Calls another system and can save what it sends back.

body.description: JSON body template; placeholders are substituted, never evaluated.

node_note.description: A note to yourself on the canvas. It never runs and never connects to anything.

node_randomizer.description: Splits people down different paths, to compare two versions. Each person keeps the path they got.

sticky.description: On by default, so somebody who comes back takes the path they had before.

node_send_email.description: Sends an email. Needs an email account connected and an address for the contact.

node_send_message.description: Sends a message. If it offers buttons or quick replies, the flow waits for an answer.

node_send_sms.description: Sends a text message. Needs an SMS account connected and a phone number for the contact.

node_smart_delay.description: Waits, then carries on. Picks up at the next hour you allow sending.

node_start_flow.description: Hands over to another flow. This one stops here.

position.description: Canvas coordinates. Builder state, ignored at runtime.
